messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The notifier depends on the bus for delivery events, so it is down whenever the bus is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11]
- The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-11, when ownership passed from the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by Cinder as of 2025-06-11, when ownership passed from the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27; recorded by handover/2025-06-11-notifier]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]
- The notifier's previous flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21]
- The notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds. [decision; valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during incident INC-2025-004. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- As of 2025-12-05, the reporting service is owned by the Ember team, having transferred from the Dune team. [decision; valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]
    earlier: The reporting service is a Dune team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-12-05; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- The notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout. [valid 2025-04-07 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-07]
- The Boreal team observed on 2025-11-03 that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-03-2]
- On 2026-04-14, the Dune team observed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-2]
- As of 2026-04-01, the indexer is owned by the Boreal team, when ownership passed from the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, when ownership passed from Cinder. [decision; valid 2025-05-20 to 2026-04-01; recorded by handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-05-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by Cinder; ownership transferred from the Atlas team on that date. [decision; valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-17, the ledger service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-07-17 to 2025-10-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-17]
    earlier: The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-07-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of 2026-02-11, the feature-flags service is owned by the Atlas team; ownership transferred from the Ember team on that date, and the Dune team never owned it. [decision; valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
    earlier: As of 2026-02-11, the feature-flags service is owned by the Dune team; ownership transferred from the Ember team on that date. [decision; valid 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-06, the feature-flags service is owned by the Ember team; ownership transferred from the Atlas team on that date. [decision; valid 2025-11-06 to 2026-02-11; recorded by handover/2025-11-06-feature-flags]
    earlier: The feature-flags service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-06; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- The Boreal team noticed on 2025-05-07 that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-05-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2]
- The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-05-15, when ownership moved from the Ember team. [valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-05-15-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Ember team, which took over ownership from the Boreal team on 2025-03-03. [valid 2025-03-03 to 2025-05-15; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-03-03; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3]

Question: Which team owns the service that the notifier depends on?
